summary: Listed in the Georgia lookout-tower list as Chatham County; no source found on its history, and the county is unverified.

evidence.supports: Lookout is listed under the name south newington in Chatham County on the Georgia tower list.

notes_for_editor: Only source is the tnlandforms Georgia list, which gives Chatham County, coordinates 32.09312, -81.33702 and a bare number 18 with no unit (the record's elevation_m 5.5 assumes feet). Searches found no tower history. A search snippet said the town of Newington is in Effingham County, not Chatham; I did not verify that, so the county is open. Check the county against the coordinates before this record is used. No story written: the evidence is one list entry, below the 120-word floor. Next steps: Georgia Forestry Commission records, Chatham County or Savannah local history collections, historic USGS topographic maps, and a check on whether South Newington is a separate place.
